notes: New 'Collapse all / Expand all' control on the Dashboard for one-tap tidying.
A friendly welcome note now greets first-time visitors above the Add a Debt form.
Collapsible sections now work with the keyboard and announce their state to screen readers.
The Escape key now closes every popup, including quick payment logging, Dial-a-Date, and celebrations.
Leave the app open across midnight or return days later - due payments and monthly interest now process the moment you come back.
Fixed: What's New release dates are now accurate; debt names containing characters like & or < display correctly everywhere.
